dedupe_keys.name: windeee downburst like impinging jet wind measurements

description: The WindEEE Dome team publishes laboratory velocity measurements from two large vertical impinging jets designed to resemble thunderstorm downburst outflows. The PANGAEA deposit is CC BY 4.0 and offers two ASCII data files. The article describes 20 repetitions at seven heights and ten radial positions, with ten-second three-component velocity series after synchronization. These observations can validate wind-field inputs in simulations of building or power-line exposure to severe local winds. A caveat is that a controlled jet is an analogue for a downburst, not a direct field record of a particular storm. Model transfer requires attention to scale, radial location, vertical profile and ensemble variation across repetitions. Companion MATLAB processing scripts have a separate Figshare address. I read the own PANGAEA metadata, rights and article Data Records without downloading the files, reproducing the jet experiment or fitting a wind model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
